    private const OPTION_SYNTAX_QUESTION_MARK = 'question_mark';

            [

                    new VersionSpecification(8_00_00)
                ),

    {
        return 2;

    {

            ? CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION // `|` -> `?`
            : CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE; // `?` -> `|`
    }

            (new FixerOptionBuilder('syntax', 'Whether to use question mark (`?`) or explicit `null` union for nullable type.'))
                ->setAllowedValues([self::OPTION_SYNTAX_UNION, self::OPTION_SYNTAX_QUESTION_MARK])
                ->setDefault(self::OPTION_SYNTAX_QUESTION_MARK)
                ->getOption(),
        ]);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->normalizeNullableType($tokens);
    }

    private function normalizeNullableType(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $tokensAnalyzer = new TokensAnalyzer($tokens);
        $elements = array_map(
            static fn (array $element): string => 'method' === $element['type'] ? 'function' : $element['type'],
            array_filter(
                $tokensAnalyzer->getClassyElements(),
                static fn (array $element): bool => \in_array($element['type'], ['method', 'property'], true)
            )
        );

        foreach ($tokens as $index => $token) {
            if (
                $token->isGivenKind(T_FN)
                || ($token->isGivenKind(T_FUNCTION) && !isset($elements[$index]))
            ) {
                $elements[$index] = 'function';
            }

            '?' => CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE,
            'array' => CT::T_ARRAY_TYPEHINT,
            'callable' => T_CALLABLE,
            'static' => T_STATIC,
        ];
        $reservedTypes = [
            'array' => true,
            'bool' => true,
            'callable' => true,
            'false' => true,
            'float' => true,
            'int' => true,
            'iterable' => true,
            'list' => true,
            'mixed' => true,
            'never' => true,
            'null' => true,
            'object' => true,
            'parent' => true,
            'resource' => true,
            'self' => true,
            'static' => true,
            'string' => true,
            'true' => true,
            'void' => true,
        ];
        $skipTypes = [
            T_ELLIPSIS,
            CT::T_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTY_PROMOTION_PUBLIC,
            CT::T_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTY_PROMOTION_PROTECTED,
            CT::T_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTY_PROMOTION_PRIVATE,
        ];
        if (\defined('T_READONLY')) {
            $skipTypes[] = T_READONLY;
        }

        $propertyModifiers = [T_PRIVATE, T_PROTECTED, T_PUBLIC, T_STATIC, T_VAR];
        if (\defined('T_READONLY')) {
            $propertyModifiers[] = T_READONLY;
        }

        $isQuestionMarkSyntax = self::OPTION_SYNTAX_QUESTION_MARK === $this->configuration['syntax'];
        $nullUnionPattern = '/(?:\|null$|^null\|)/i';

        try {
            ExecutorWithoutErrorHandler::execute(static fn () => preg_match($nullUnionPattern, ''));
        } catch (ExecutorWithoutErrorHandlerException $exception) {
            throw new PregException($exception->getMessage(), (int) $exception->getCode());
        }

        foreach (array_reverse($elements, true) as $index => $elementType) {
            $pendingTypes = [];

            if ('property' === $elementType) {
                $propertyEndIndex = $index;
                $propertyIndex = $index;

                do {
                    $propertyIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($propertyIndex);
                } while (!$tokens[$propertyIndex]->isGivenKind($propertyModifiers));

                $rawPropertyType = '';
                $propertyTypeStartIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($propertyIndex);
                $propertyTypeEndIndex = $propertyTypeStartIndex;

                for ($i = $propertyTypeStartIndex; $i < $propertyEndIndex; ++$i) {
                    if ($tokens[$i]->isWhitespace() || $tokens[$i]->isComment()) {
                        continue;
                    }

                    $rawPropertyType .= $tokens[$i]->getContent();
                    $propertyTypeEndIndex = $i;
                }

                if ('' !== $rawPropertyType) {
                    $pendingTypes[] = new TypeAnalysis($rawPropertyType, $propertyTypeStartIndex, $propertyTypeEndIndex);
                }
            } else {
                $argumentsStart = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, ['(']);
                $argumentsEnd = $tokens->findBlockEnd(Tokens::BLOCK_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_BRACE, $argumentsStart);
                $typeColonIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($argumentsEnd);

                    $rawReturnType = '';

                        if ($tokens[$i]->isWhitespace() || $tokens[$i]->isComment()) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        $rawReturnType .= $tokens[$i]->getContent();
                        $returnTypeEndIndex = $i;

                        $pendingTypes[] = new TypeAnalysis($rawReturnType, $returnTypeStartIndex, $returnTypeEndIndex);
                    }

                $firstSensibleToken = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($argumentsStart);

                    $paramContentIndex = $argumentsStart + 1;
                    $argumentsRangeStart = $paramContentIndex;

                            $argumentRanges[$argumentsRangeStart] = $paramContentIndex - 1;
                            $argumentsRangeStart = $paramContentIndex + 1;

                    $argumentRanges[$argumentsRangeStart] = $paramContentIndex - 1;

                        'name' => null,
                        'name_index' => null,
                        'type' => null,
                        'type_index_start' => null,
                        'type_index_end' => null,

                            || $argumentToken->equals('&')

                            $info['name_index'] = $argumentIndex;
                            $info['name'] = $argumentToken->getContent();

                            continue;
                        }

                        if ($argumentToken->equals('=')) {
                            continue;

                            $info['default'] .= $argumentToken->getContent();
                        } else {
                            $info['type_index_start'] = ($info['type_index_start'] > 0) ? $info['type_index_start'] : $argumentIndex;

                        ? new TypeAnalysis($info['type'], $info['type_index_start'], $info['type_index_end'])
                        : null;
                    $argumentAnalysis = new ArgumentAnalysis(
                        $info['name'],
                        $info['name_index'],
                        $info['default'],
                        $argumentTypeAnalysis
                    );

                    if ($argumentAnalysis->hasTypeAnalysis()) {
                        $pendingTypes[] = $argumentAnalysis->getTypeAnalysis();
                    }
                }
            }

            foreach ($pendingTypes as $typeAnalysis) {
                $typeName = $typeAnalysis->getName();
                $lowerTypeName = strtolower($typeName);

                if ('null' === $lowerTypeName || !$typeAnalysis->isNullable() || str_contains($typeName, '&')) {
                    continue;
                }

                $isNormalizable = false;
                if (!str_contains($typeName, '|')) {
                    $isNormalizable = true;
                } elseif (1 === substr_count($typeName, '|')) {
                    $matches = [];
                    $matchResult = @preg_match($nullUnionPattern.'u', $typeName, $matches);
                    if (false === $matchResult || PREG_NO_ERROR !== preg_last_error()) {
                        $matchResult = @preg_match($nullUnionPattern, $typeName, $matches);
                    }

                    $isNormalizable = false !== $matchResult && 1 === $matchResult;
                }

                if (!$isNormalizable) {
                    continue;
                }

                $type = $typeName;
                if (!str_contains($type, '|') && !str_contains($type, '&')) {
                    $type = ($typeAnalysis->isNullable() ? '?' : '').$type;
                }

                if ($isQuestionMarkSyntax) {
                    if (str_starts_with($type, '?')) {
                        $normalizedType = [$type];
                    } else {
                        $replaceCount = null;
                        $stripped = @preg_replace($nullUnionPattern.'u', '', $type, -1, $replaceCount);
                        if (null === $stripped || PREG_NO_ERROR !== preg_last_error()) {
                            $stripped = @preg_replace($nullUnionPattern, '', $type, -1, $replaceCount);
                        }

                        $normalizedType = ['?', $stripped];
                    }

                    $normalizedTypeAsString = implode('', $normalizedType);
                } else {
                    if (str_contains($type, '|')) {
                        $normalizedType = [$type];
                    } else {
                        $normalizedType = ['null', substr($type, 1)];
                    }

                    $normalizedTypeAsString = implode('|', $normalizedType);
                }

                if ($normalizedTypeAsString === $type) {
                    continue;
                }

                $typeCount = \count($normalizedType);
                $newTokens = [];

                foreach ($normalizedType as $normalizedIndex => $normalizedPart) {
                    $lowerPart = strtolower($normalizedPart);

                    if (isset($specialTypes[$lowerPart])) {
                        $newTokens[] = new Token([$specialTypes[$lowerPart], $normalizedPart]);
                    } elseif (isset($reservedTypes[$lowerPart])) {
                        $newTokens[] = new Token([T_STRING, $normalizedPart]);
                    } else {
                        foreach (explode('\\', $normalizedPart) as $nsIndex => $value) {
                            if (0 === $nsIndex) {
                                if ('' === $value) {
                                    continue;
                                }

                                $newTokens[] = new Token([T_STRING, $value]);
                            } else {
                                $newTokens[] = new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']);
                                $newTokens[] = new Token([T_STRING, $value]);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if ($normalizedIndex <= $typeCount - 2 && !$isQuestionMarkSyntax) {
                        $newTokens[] = new Token([CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION, '|']);
                    }
                }

                $indexStart = $typeAnalysis->getStartIndex();
                $indexEnd = $typeAnalysis->getEndIndex();
                $indexToChange = $indexEnd - $indexStart + 1;
                $itemsCount = \count($newTokens);

                if ($itemsCount > $indexToChange) {
                    $placeholders = [];

                    while ($itemsCount > $indexToChange) {
                        $placeholders[] = new Token('__PLACEHOLDER__');
                        ++$indexToChange;
                    }

                    $tokens->insertAt($indexEnd + 1, $placeholders);
                }

                foreach ($newTokens as $itemIndex => $item) {
                    $tokens[$indexStart + $itemIndex] = $item;
                }

                if ($itemsCount < $indexToChange) {
                    $tokens->clearRange($indexStart + $itemsCount, $indexEnd);
                }

                if (!$tokens[$typeAnalysis->getStartIndex() - 1]->equals('(')) {
                    $tokens->ensureWhitespaceAtIndex($typeAnalysis->getStartIndex() - 1, 1, ' ');
                }
            }
        }
    }
